escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in Asia this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, FREE FIRE INDIA IS HERE!, by Free Fire India Official, with over 27 thousand comments.
In second place, Tennis Ball 🥎, by What Factzz, with over 45 thousand comments.
And number one: INDIA’S GOT LATENT S2 EP8 ft. MC Stan, Tanmay Bhat…, by Samay Raina, with over 45 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
